result:
Three of my four finish objections rested on mistakes; here they are corrected against the ranges you specified.

## Corrections

**Reduced-motion fallback exists — I was wrong.** `index.html:1145` carries the `hidden` attribute on `.ai-arrival`, so with JS off or motion reduced the stage never paints and the fallback is the existing hero: eager `main-street-dusk.webp`, kicker, `#hero-title`, lede, namecheck, and all three CTAs (`:1144`–`:1164`). `no-js-320.png` shows exactly that, intact and correct. `functional-checks.json` records both "reduced motion static fallback" and "no-JavaScript markup keeps arrival hidden" as passing. My "owner sees a blank stage" claim was false, and the viewing condition I attached to it is withdrawn — nothing here depends on Ali's motion settings.

**Session flag is not a brief contradiction.** The brief bars an "infinite arrival loop," which a one-shot-per-session flag is the mechanism *against*, and the readable `Replay arrival` control is deliberate and in-flow at `index.html:1158`, inside `.hero-copy` after the namecheck. I over-read the source comment as a storage prohibition. Withdrawn as a blocker; I'd keep one operational sentence for whoever demos it, that a same-tab reload lands on the completed homepage with Replay, which is the intended state, not a fault.

**Sprite rectangles are the hardware, not containers.** Re-reading `final-icons-1440.png`: the pink rectangle with two reels and a label window is the cassette shell itself. I misread object outlines as added badge chrome. Withdrawn. The `.32em` symbol vs `.15em` dot (`arrival.css:10-11`) is still an accurate measurement, but as object scale for admitted hardware sprites it's a design choice, not a defect. Crave being a motion reference rather than a copy target also disposes of my neon-outline and recolour notes.

**Masthead palette.** Premised on a morph into the header mark that isn't the design — the header stays visible throughout in every frame I looked at. Withdrawn.

**Phone evidence gap closed.** `return-390.png`: full LAiDIES spans ~28–360 of 390, centre ~194 against 195. `return-320.png`: ~22–297 of 320, centre ~159.5 against 160. Centred, uncropped, even margins at both widths, caption clear below. This confirms `full=Math.min(1,root.clientWidth*.86/w)` in pixels, not just by construction.

Worth noting as positive evidence I'd missed: the word uses `ı` (U+0131, dotless i) at `index.html:1148`, so the dot and symbol slots are the only dot. That's deliberate type work and it's why the substitution reads cleanly.

## Remaining items — all optional taste, no blockers

- Closing sweep runs 5.87–6.2 while the stage fade runs 5.98–6.2 (`arrival.js:23-24`), so the second bookend is short. Both bookends are present; this is pacing preference.
- Retreating L/DIES hold their `text-shadow` proportionally as opacity drops, reading flat grey for a few mid-transition frames (`continuous-01`, row 3 col 2).
- Pause/Skip sit top-right of a tall phone stage. Targets are ≥44px so this meets the floor; low placement would just be easier one-handed.
- `--arrival-top` is recomputed only in `start()` and the `ResizeObserver` (`arrival.js:13,31`), so it goes stale if someone scrolls mid-arrival. Minor robustness, not visible in any supplied frame.
- `brief.md:6` cites input "index.html b5999d7b", which doesn't correspond to the bound value. Probably a different hash form; worth reconciling in the paperwork sometime, irrelevant to what renders.

## Verdict

**ADMIT_FOR_OWNER_PREVIEW** — unconditional. Bound to `index.html` SHA256 `614cd25493fc99269f4b5d761557ad12a5e682dc5927e530373140f7f3e6bb95`, which matches the `index.html` entry in `artifact-bindings.json`.

No unresolved blockers. The Ai/full-name relationship holds, the word is centred and uncropped at 1440/390/320, the six-frame sprite strip is real in code (`background-size:600% 100%`, `icon*20%`, six 0.38s slots), controls and fallback behave, and the completed homepage preserves all three CTAs with Replay in reserved in-flow space.

## Limitations

- No shell, so no SHA recomputed. The match above is a string comparison against `artifact-bindings.json`; I cannot confirm the other five files hash to their bound values.
- Easing smoothness across the approach and retreat is still unjudged — stills can't show it, and I'm not inferring frames I didn't see. That's the one brief acceptance item I can't speak to.
- Screenshots are captured paused ("Resume arrival" showing), so these are held states, not live playback.
- `functional-checks.json` is a declared result set; I read it, I didn't execute the checks.
- Small pixel figures carry downscaling error of roughly ±10px.
- I make no claim about any repository presentation gate. This is a review of this packet only.
